episodes.name: Spider and the Fly
episodes.overview: Gibbs must take desperate measures to protect his loved ones with Paloma Reynosa still on the loose.

episodes.name: Worst Nightmare
episodes.overview: The NCIS team has to find a young girl that was kidnapped, but their investigation turns into something else when her grandfather gets way too involved.

episodes.name: Short Fuse
episodes.overview: The team investigates a bomb tech's guarded personal life after she is attacked.

episodes.name: Royals and Loyals
episodes.overview: The team hopes to avoid an international incident when an American officer is killed on a British ship.

episodes.name: Dead Air
episodes.overview: The team uncovers a sinister plan when a controversial DJ and a Naval officer are shot to death.

episodes.name: Cracked
episodes.overview: Abby becomes fixated on solving a murder, while DiNozzo's latest fling leads to an interesting Halloween.

episodes.name: Broken Arrow
episodes.overview: The team is surprised when Gibbs asks Tony's father to join them in a murder investigation.

episodes.name: Enemies Foreign (1)
episodes.overview: The team is assigned to protect Ziva's father, when his attendance at a NCIS conference leads to some unexpected surprises.

episodes.name: Enemies Domestic (2)
episodes.overview: The team scrambles for answers after a shocking ambush reveals a new twist to their current investigation.

episodes.name: False Witness
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates the disappearance of a Petty Officer who is the sole witness in an upcoming murder trial.

episodes.name: Ships in the Night
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the NCIS team partner with a Coast Guard Investigative Service (CGIS) Agent to solve the murder of a Marine gunned down on a dinner boat.

episodes.name: Recruited
episodes.overview: A Petty Officer's recruitment session at a college fair comes to a fatal end, prompting the NCIS team, accompanied by Dr. Mallard's predecessor, to solve his murder.

episodes.name: Freedom
episodes.overview: The NCIS team springs into action to find the assailant responsible for beating a Marine to death in his own backyard.

episodes.name: A Man Walks Into a Bar ...
episodes.overview: The NCIS team undergoes mandatory psych evaluations while investigating the death of a Naval Commander.

episodes.name: Defiance
episodes.overview: A botched assassination attempt in Belgravia forces NCIS to protect the Defense Minister's daughter, who is studying in the U.S. and smitten with McGee.

episodes.name: Kill Screen
episodes.overview: The dismembered fingertips and teeth of a murdered Marine are discovered in the stolen purse of a pickpocketer, launching NCIS on a mission to find a cold-blooded killer.

episodes.name: One Last Score
episodes.overview: NCIS discovers that one of its former investigative assistants found brutally stabbed to death was selling details for how to rob a warehouse full of valuable possessions belonging to a woman convicted of fraud.

episodes.name: Out of the Frying Pan...
episodes.overview: Gibbs questions Vance's motives when he is asked to interrogate a teenage boy accused of killing his retired Marine father.

episodes.name: Tell-All
episodes.overview: NCIS connects a message in blood left by a murdered Navy commander to a manuscript that may contain classified military information.

episodes.name: Two-Faced
episodes.overview: To Gibbs' displeasure, Special Agent E.J. Barrett returns to lead the investigation of a seaman's death that may be connected to a series of port-related murders.

episodes.name: Dead Reflection
episodes.overview: The NCIS team tracks a Navy Lieutenant's killer after a Pentagon security camera reveals a Petty Officer committing the crime.

episodes.name: Baltimore
episodes.overview: After Tony's ex-partner, Danny Price, appears to be the Port-to-Port Killer's latest victim, he revisits his days as a detective in Baltimore, including his first encounter with Gibbs.

episodes.name: Swan Song
episodes.overview: After new evidence reveals that the Port-to-Port Killer has infiltrated the agency, the NCIS team chases every lead in a race to track him down.

episodes.name: Pyramid
episodes.overview: The lives of NCIS members are in jeopardy when they come face-to-face with the infamous Port-to-Port Killer.
